module: Screenshot capture on the Game Engine side. It prepares the file name (folder screenshots/<month>/screenshot_<date>), the quality options (supersampling, scaling), the metadata (level, vehicles, sharing), and launches the capture via the engine (createScreenshot2). It tracks each capture as a "job" (queued, in progress, saving, done, error) and notifies the UI. It also handles the upload to the BeamNG media server, the list of the latest photo mode photos and the restoring of the graphics settings after a high-quality capture.
usage:
screenshot.takeScreenShot()            -- normal capture
screenshot.takeBigScreenShot()         -- 2x linear (4x pixels)
screenshot.takeCustomScreenShot(4, 1)  -- supersampling 4, rescale 1
notes: The takeXxxScreenShot functions accept flexible positional arguments: (splitSceneVehicle, saveNormalDepth, options...) or, if the first argument is a table, the booleans are read at positions c and d. A table passed in the last or second-to-last position is interpreted as 'options' (callOrigin, upload, jsonMetaData, includeMetadata, persistMetadataSidecar, forceSidecar).

Supersampling is the TOTAL pixel multiplier (1 = native, 4 = 2x linear, 9 = 3x linear). It is capped by a GPU budget (getMaxSafeScreenshotSuperSampling): Big 4, Huge 9, Custom/MotionBlur up to 24. High values can hang or crash some GPU drivers.

From a supersampling >= 9 (highest), the module temporarily sets $pref::TS::detailAdjust to 20, $pref::Terrain::lodScale to 0.001 and the grass scale to 8; with supersampling > 1 it also sets the volumetric cloud layer (256 steps). screenshotAllDone restores the original values.

Only one capture at a time: doScreenshot, takeBig and takeHuge exit if captureInProgress is true (log 'ignoring screenshot capture'). captureInProgress is reset to false by screenshotAllDone. takeScreenShot, takeCustom and takeMotionBlur do not test this lock.
takeMotionBlurScreenShot calls exactly the same code as takeCustomScreenShot: no motion blur processing is visible in it.
File formats come from the settings 'screenshotFormat' (png by default, jpg/jpeg possible). doScreenshot can receive a forced path and extension.
The functions screenshotProgress, screenshotTaken, screenshotSaved, screenshotUploaded and screenshotAllDone are called by the C++ engine; do not call them yourself.
The phases of a job (phase field): 'queue' -> 'in progress' -> 'saving' -> 'done' or 'error'. result == 0 means success.
The upload (publish) is refused if the onlineFeatures setting is not 'enable'. doSteamScreenshot also requires onlineFeatures, but takes a photo then calls OnlineServiceProvider.triggerScreenshot().
The module also writes a sidecar file or metadata embedded in the image (writeScreenshotEmbeddedMetadata) with level, vehicles, share link, used by getPhotomodeRollEntries.

Dynamically created fields: hqActive, cloudHqActive, sc_detailAdjustSaved, sc_lodScaleSaved, sc_GroundCoverScaleSaved, sc_cloudDownsampleSaved, sc_cloudStepCountSaved, sc_cloudSunShadowStepCountSaved (state saved during a high-quality capture).

hqActive.desc: true while the high-quality graphics settings of a capture are applied; reset to false by clearScreenshotJobs and screenshotAllDone.

cloudHqActive.desc: true while the cloud layer is in capture mode (full resolution, more steps).

clearScreenshotJobs.desc: Forgets all capture jobs (lists, metadata, pending uploads), resets hqActive to false and notifies the UI.

createScreenshotTracked.desc: Creates a capture in the engine (createScreenshot2) from a copy of the parameters table and registers the job for tracking (filename, bufferType, type, metadata, upload). Sets captureInProgress.

p.desc: Capture parameters: filename, writeJPG, superSampling, tiles, overlap, rescaleFactor, upload, jsonMetaData (JSON string), persistMetadataSidecar, bufferType ('color', 'depth'…), jobType, object masks (objectTypeWhitelistMask…), etc.

returns.desc: Job id returned by the engine (nil or 0 if creation fails).

doScreenshot.desc: Takes a simple capture (scale 1, a single tile) with a unique file name 'screenshot_<date>[_n]'. If path and ext are provided, uses this path and ignores upload and batchTag. Attaches the metadata if requested or if upload.

batchTag.desc: Batch tag (ignored if path/ext are provided; not used afterwards in the code read).

upload.desc: true to send the capture to the media server.

ext.desc: Extension/format ('png' or 'jpg'), to be provided with path.

doSteamScreenshot.desc: Takes a capture then asks the online service provider (Steam) to trigger its capture. Refused if onlineFeatures is not 'enable'.

options.desc: Options; options.upload == true also sends the capture.

getPhotomodeRollEntries.desc: Lists the latest main photo mode captures (files 'screenshot_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS', excluding _scene/_vehicle/_normal/_depth), most recent first, with share link and metadata read from the sidecar file or the embedded metadata.

limit.desc: Maximum number of entries (10 by default). A value <= 0 searches recursively in all screenshots folders with no limit.

returns.desc: List of {gamePath = string, shareUrl = string|nil, metadata = table|nil, openMap = table|nil}.

getPhotomodeRollEntriesJson.desc: Same result as getPhotomodeRollEntries but encoded as a JSON string, for the UI (tables do not always pass well to Angular/CEF).

getScreenshotCompletion.desc: Returns the final state of a capture job, only if it is finished ('done') or in error ('error').

returns.desc: {id, result, filename, phase}, or nil if the job is unknown or not finished.

getScreenshotJobsSnapshotJson.desc: Snapshot of the running jobs as JSON: id, runId, percent, message, phase, result, filename, bufferType, type, metadata, openMap.

isDebugTracingEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the module's '[Trace]' trace logs are enabled.

openScreenshotFileInExplorer.desc: Opens the system file explorer on a capture. Does nothing (with a warning) if the file does not exist or if the path is empty.

openScreenshotsFolderInExplorer.desc: Creates the screenshots/<month> folder if needed and opens it in the file explorer.

publish.desc: Takes a capture and sends it to the BeamNG media server. Refused with an error toast if onlineFeatures is not 'enable'.

runPhotomodeFlashCapture.desc: Single entry point for the old photo mode UI callbacks: loads the util/photomodeFlash extension and calls util_photomodeFlash.runCapture(kind, ...).

kind.desc: Capture type requested from the extension (values defined in util/photomodeFlash).

screenshotAllDone.desc: Called by the engine when all the jobs of a series are finished: restores the original graphics and cloud settings, releases the reserved file names, resets captureInProgress to false, emits the onScreenshotAllDone hook and the UI event ScreenshotJobsAllDone.

screenshotProgress.desc: Called by the engine: updates the percentage and message of a job ('in progress' phase) and notifies the UI.

screenshotSaved.desc: Called by the engine when the image is written to disk. res == 0: success ('done' phase, 100%, writing of the metadata sidecar file if planned); otherwise 'error' phase.

screenshotTaken.desc: Called by the engine when the image is captured on the GPU side but not yet written: puts the job in the 'saving' phase.

screenshotUploaded.desc: Called by the engine at the end of an upload: writes the share link into the sidecar file, notifies the UI (ScreenshotUploadComplete) and displays a success or failure toast (result == 0 = success).

result.desc: Result code, 0 = success (1 by default if invalid).

setDebugTracingEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the module's trace logs.

value.desc: true to enable (any other value disables).

takeBigScreenShot.desc: "Big" capture: supersampling 4 (2x linear, 4x pixels). A 1080p screen gives a 4K image. Ignored if a capture is already in progress.

a.desc: splitSceneVehicle (also save scene and vehicle separately), or an options table.

c.desc: Options table, or splitSceneVehicle if a is a table.

d.desc: Options table, or saveNormalDepth if a is a table.

takeCustomScreenShot.desc: Capture with chosen supersampling and scaling (limited to 24 and to the GPU budget). Above 9 the risk of a driver freeze is real.

superSampling.desc: Total pixel multiplier (1 native, 4 = 2x linear, 9 = 3x linear).

rescaleFactor.desc: Final resize factor (1 if invalid or <= 0).

c.desc: Options table, or splitSceneVehicle if a is a table.

d.desc: Options table, or saveNormalDepth if a is a table.

takeHugeScreenShot.desc: "Huge" capture: supersampling 9 (3x linear, 9x pixels), with maximum graphics settings. 1080p gives about 6K, 4K gives about 12K. Ignored if a capture is already in progress.

c.desc: Options table, or splitSceneVehicle if a is a table.

d.desc: Options table, or saveNormalDepth if a is a table.

takeMotionBlurScreenShot.desc: Same behavior as takeCustomScreenShot (same internal call): see the notes on the absence of specific motion blur processing.

superSampling.desc: Total pixel multiplier (limited to 24 and to the GPU budget).

takeScreenShot.desc: "Normal" capture at native resolution (1080p gives a 1080p image). Can additionally save separate scene/vehicle images and normals/depth.

a.desc: splitSceneVehicle (true to save scene and vehicle separately) or options table.

b.desc: saveNormalDepth (true to save normals and depth).

c.desc: Options table, or splitSceneVehicle if a is a table.

d.desc: Options table, or saveNormalDepth if a is a table.
